nodes.statement: Fix one admitted actual process token or overlapping process family P, interval I, complete signature K, selected activity target tau, endpoint c, bearer-state variable v, background class G, and admissible endpoint intervention family J_c.
nodes.scope: One target-relative actual application; abstract finite witnesses do not discharge actual admission.

nodes.statement: PC_tau holds when the selected activity has both an actually used directive route and an actually used consequence-closure route; it is inherited from R181 and does not imply movement, success, report, ownership, or voluntary endorsement.
nodes.scope: Same fixed target tau and actual route instance as R190:DOMAIN.

nodes.statement: BDCC_tau holds when a predeclared intervention on selected endpoint c changes declared bearer state v through a typed actual endpoint-to-bearer path under fixed backgrounds, with path membership fixed independently of report, desired feeling, or test outcome.
nodes.scope: Target-specific restricted reuse of R158 coupling/efficacy and R159 carrier/reference distinctions; no generic bodily-response shortcut.

nodes.statement: Five modes—enacted, remote/isolated action, active imagery, passive impact, and detached observation—crossed with source, substrate, report, spillover, and yoke labels form 160 explicit configurations.
nodes.scope: Declared finite construction only; mode labels abbreviate the displayed route equations.

nodes.statement: All four Boolean PC_tau/BDCC_tau combinations occur in the five-mode witness, so neither coordinate entails the other inside the declared construction.
nodes.scope: Model-relative existence, not universal or population independence.

nodes.statement: Within the five-mode family, PC_tau AND BDCC_tau selects enacted bearer-involving action and excludes isolated imagery, remote/isolated action, passive impact, and detached observation for the selected overt endpoint.
nodes.scope: Declared modes and fixed selected endpoint only; other target-relative instances may differ.

nodes.statement: A deliberate/reflex source swap can preserve every declared PC and BDCC field, so the conjunction does not identify voluntary endorsement, felt trying, agency, ownership, or familiar mineness.
nodes.scope: Explicit twin countermodel; no claim that real reflex and deliberate episodes share complete organization.

nodes.statement: A positive intervention or diagnostic result may evidence a path under a contract but does not by itself prove that the target episode actually used that path; carrier, consumer, timing, boundary, and same-instance membership remain independent premises.
nodes.scope: Actual applications and empirical tests; not a claim that tests are irrelevant.

nodes.statement: A UCT application requires joint same-instance evidence for P,I,K,tau,c,v, all PC/BDCC route carriers and consumers, background/intervention contract, and selected evidence target.
nodes.scope: Actual application only; finite code, reports, substrate labels, or generic physiology do not discharge the conjunction.

nodes.statement: If R190 same-instance grounding is independently discharged, the PC+BDCC profile is part of actual experiential organization under C1 while remaining unnecessary for basal experience under U1 and insufficient for any named self-feeling.
nodes.scope: Conditional organization-level interpretation; no scalar experience, subject count, exclusive owner, or current-system verdict.

rules.statement: Read the four witnessed profile values under one typed target-relative contract.
rules.binding: Each row has one fixed target contract; the proposition ranges over alternative rows and does not conjoin them into one token.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: The four truth-value rows are alternative witnesses, not simultaneous routes.

rules.statement: Apply PC_tau AND BDCC_tau to the five declared alternative modes.
rules.binding: One fixed target-relative row at a time; no global bodily effect substitutes for selected BDCC.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Mode comparison branches are alternatives; the all_of list joins definitions and one construction contract.

rules.statement: Hold every selected route field fixed while replacing only the declared source label.
rules.binding: Paired alternative rows share all modeled organization except the deliberate/reflex source label; they do not assert complete real-world identity.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: The twin is a sufficiency counterexample, not a positive phenomenal classification.

rules.statement: Preserve the inference direction from an independently fixed actual path to admissible evidence, not from test success alone to episode use.
rules.binding: One episode, route, intervention contract, and evidence time; reserve and neighboring routes remain distinct candidates.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Multiple evidence routes may support one premise, but none is definitionally identical to actual use.

rules.statement: Interpret the independently grounded same-instance profile as organization inside experience, while preserving U1 and the named-feeling limit.
rules.binding: All actual carriers, consumers, interval, boundary, target, path, and intervention premises concern the same admitted application.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: No toy row, report, or successful diagnostic substitutes for the full actual-premise conjunction.

context_links.statement: BDCC reuses R158's typed coupling/efficacy distinction and keeps feeling, judgment, report, membership, and coupling separate.
Selected bearer coupling is not anatomical membership and can be separately typed for external or prosthetic endpoints.
The two-coordinate bodily/action organization leaves the familiar-mineness bridge open.
PC and BDCC may structure selected experience but are not added as requirements for basal experience.
